 ingredients:

 sauce ingredients:
 1 tablespoon of tomato sauce.
🥫 3 tablespoons of tomato sauce, 
1 can of tomato sauce, 

stuffing ingredients: 
300 grams of chicken breast, 
3 bell peppers, 
2 dried onions,
 salt, 
black pepper, 
red chili powder, 
½ cup of vegetable oil. 

Cut the chicken breast into small pieces, slice the bell peppers and onions into strips. Heat oil in a pan, sauté the peppers and onions until fragrant, then add the chicken breast and cook until fully cooked. Season with spices and salt. Use 2 fried potatoes and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese. Bake in an oven preheated to 200°C for 15 minutes.
